issue.title: fix(acp-server): surface provider errors on session/prompt

llm_context.input_title: fix(acp-server): surface provider errors on session/prompt
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: When LLM provider errors (such as 4xx/5xx/rate-limits/connection errors) occur during an ACP session prompt or turn, the ACP server silently resolves the turn with a successful stopReason ('end_turn') instead of propagating a JSON-RPC error. This issue proposes surfacing these provider errors properly as JSON-RPC internal errors via a new `isProviderError` helper.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The error classification logic in `packages/acp-server/src/session.ts` and `packages/acp-server/src/events-map.ts` exclusively checks for authentication errors (`isAuthError`) and maps everything else through `turnEndReasonToStopReason`. The underlying engine correctly tags errors with codes like `provider.api_error`, but the ACP layer discards this differentiation.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect existing error classification helpers
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect symbol isAuthError in packages/acp-server/src/events-map.ts and mapPromptLaunchError in packages/acp-server/src/session.ts to understand how errors are currently categorized.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement isProviderError helper
step_by_step_plan.description: Add an isProviderError helper function in packages/acp-server/src/events-map.ts to detect recognized provider error codes such as provider.api_error, rate limits, and connection errors.

step_by_step_plan.title: Update turn end and prompt launch error handling
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify onTurnEnded and mapPromptLaunchError in packages/acp-server/src/session.ts to check for provider errors using the new helper and reject the driver with a structured JSON-RPC internal error instead of falling back to end_turn.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test for provider error propagation
step_by_step_plan.description: Add unit tests in packages/acp-server/test/convert.test.ts (or session test suite) verifying that provider errors are correctly propagated as JSON-RPC internal errors.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run test suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Run the repository test command to verify all tests pass successfully without regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Translating internal application or provider failures into standardized remote procedure call error responses.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Ensures that clients calling remote APIs are explicitly notified of failures rather than receiving misleading success responses.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Fixes the silent resolution of provider failures so that API clients receive proper JSON-RPC error codes instead of a false 'end_turn' success signal.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Categorizing error codes from lower layers to handle specific failure modes differently at the application boundary.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Allows servers to adapt generic engine failures into specific client-facing protocols like authentication requests or internal error reporting.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Introduces `isProviderError` alongside `isAuthError` to properly route provider-specific error codes to JSON-RPC rejections.

common_pitfalls: Exposing internal server stack traces or raw unmasked secrets directly across the JSON-RPC wire boundary.
Forgetting to update both prompt-launch error mapping and turn-ended settlement handlers.
